states.name: Alice
states.title: The Dream's Origin
states.description: She is the "original" Alice, who had become imprisoned in a warped, endlessly repeating Wonderland since its creation. She adores stories, and she never forgets her curiosity or smile in any circumstance. Even after solitude of unimaginable length, she loves nothing more than to chat with another person.

states.name: Alice
states.title: The Dream's Origin
states.description: She has always loved making up stories. Whenever something interesting happens, she immediately turns it into a tale in her head. Her favorite is the story of a girl who follows a white rabbit with a watch into Wonderland. But each time she tells it, the ending changes—little by little, towards a bad end.

states.name: Alice
states.title: The Dream's Origin
states.description: There was a white feather charm that she treasured, a gift from a precious friend she met in this world. This friend insisted that "it's just a silly little good-luck charm," but when the friend nearly lost it once,  she was uncharacteristically close to tears.
